stories.title: What we know about Ronald Alan Rutledge, wanted for shooting at Stevens County deputies
stories.summary: Rutledge has prompted manhunts before, after he escaped from Whitman County Jail in 2010 and from Lincoln County Jail in 2015.

stories.title: WSD closes parking area amid auditorium concerns
stories.summary: Students at Wallace Jr./Sr. High School are being forced to park elsewhere as ongoing deterioration at the nearby Wallace Civic Auditorium has escalated.

stories.title: Hayden to consider contract with Kootenai County Sheriff's Office
stories.summary: Once again, the Hayden City Council will consider a nearly $1 million contract with Kootenai County for continued law enforcement services when it meets at 5 p.m.

stories.title: Post Falls man petitions against animal abuse
stories.summary: A Post Falls man wants stronger protections for animals in Idaho and has collected 1,600 signatures on a petition.

stories.title: U.S. Marshals Service identifies the suspect accused of shooting at Stevens County deputies
stories.summary: Law enforcement is offering $3,500 for information leading to the arrest of 45-year-old Ronald Rutledge, the suspect in a Stevens County shooting over the weekend.

stories.title: Here's what's closed in Spokane County this Thanksgiving
stories.summary: Thanksgiving closures will hit all county offices through Friday.

stories.title: 3 residents, 3 dogs displaced after early morning house fire in Whitman neighborhood
stories.summary: The American Red Cross responded early Tuesday morning to an aid request for three residents and dogs displaced by a house fire.

stories.title: You can help share the spirit of giving through the Tree of Sharing starting Friday, November 27
stories.summary: The organization, made up of a small but mighty group of volunteers, works each year to provide everyone with a special gift at Christmas.

stories.title: 'So cruel': Husband of woman detained by ICE at SEA Airport says ICE operations must change
stories.summary: José Castillo said federal officers "stalked" his family through SEA Airport, rushed them without identification and traumatized the family and other passengers.

stories.title: 875,000 expected through SEA Airport for Thanksgiving, despite recent travel disruptions
stories.summary: The Port of Seattle says this year's passenger estimate is on par with 2025; AAA says about 6 million people will fly for the holiday nationwide.

stories.title: Seattle eyes a World Cup encore with 2031 Women's World Cup bid
stories.summary: Seattle is among 30 cities vying to host the 2031 Women's World Cup games. Local leaders say last summer's success gives the city an edge.

stories.title: Man accused of kidnapping, raping Spokane teen held on $500K bond
stories.summary: According to court documents, 43-year-old Danny Willis, a registered sex offender, is accused of kidnapping and raping a 14-year-old in East Spokane in June.
